code='''from collections import deque\ndef transform(grid):\n    a=[row[:] for row in grid]; h=len(a); w=len(a[0]); bg=a[0][0]\n    seen=set(); q=deque()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1):\n                if a[r][c]==bg and (r,c) not in seen: seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))\n    while q:\n        r,c=q.popleft()\n        for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):\n            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and a[nr][nc]==bg and (nr,nc) not in seen: seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if a[r][c]==bg and (r,c) not in seen: a[r][c]=7\n    return a\n'''
